columns.sql:
SELECT ((CASE WHEN "t0"."request_host" IS NULL
                                THEN CASE WHEN "t0"."current_domain" IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN '/_main_/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || "t0"."id"
                                    ELSE '/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || "t0"."id" END
                                ELSE "t0"."request_host" || CASE WHEN "t0"."current_domain" IS NOT NULL
                                    THEN '/_main_/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || "t0"."id"
                                    ELSE '/sys/ep_error?error_id=' || "t0"."id" END
                             END)
                            ) AS "detail_url" FROM "sys"."sys_error" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."task_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."start_ts" IS NOT NULL AND "s1_t0"."end_ts" IS NULL) AS "active_workers" FROM "sys"."sys_task" AS "t0"
SELECT (SELECT MAX("s1_t0"."start_time") AS "__value_0" FROM "sys"."sys_task_result" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."task_id" = "t0"."id") AS "last_result_ts" FROM "sys"."sys_task" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT "s1_t0"."end_ts" AS "end_ts" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."task_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."end_ts" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "s1_t0"."end_ts" DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_completed" FROM "sys"."sys_task" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT "s1_t0"."start_ts" AS "start_ts" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."task_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."is_error" IS TRUE ORDER BY "s1_t0"."start_ts" DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_error" FROM "sys"."sys_task" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."table_name" AS "task_table" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."task_name" AS "task_name" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."command" AS "task_command" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."stopped" AS "task_stopped" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."parameters" AS "task_parameters" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."saved_query_code" AS "task_saved_query" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."worker_code" AS "task_worker_code" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."max_workers" AS "task_max_workers" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."task_id"="t1"."id" AND "s1_t0"."start_ts" IS NOT NULL AND "s1_t0"."end_ts" IS NULL) AS "task_active_workers" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_task" AS "t1" ON "t0"."task_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (
            (CASE WHEN "t0"."is_error" IS TRUE THEN 'error'
                 WHEN "t0"."end_ts" IS NOT NULL THEN 'completed'
                 WHEN "t0"."start_ts" IS NOT NULL THEN 'running'
                 ELSE 'waiting'
            END)
        ) AS "status" FROM "sys"."sys_task_execution" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "sys"."sys_widget" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "sys"."sys_widget" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."id" = "s1_t1"."parent_id" WHERE "s1_t1"."parent_id"="t0"."id") AS "child_count" FROM "sys"."sys_widget" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT (COALESCE("s1_t1"."__syscode","s1_t1"."hierarchical_code")) AS "tag_id_authorization_tag" FROM "adm"."adm_api_token_tag" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."tag_id" = "s1_t1"."id" WHERE "s1_t0"."api_token_id"="t0"."id") AS "all_tags" FROM "adm"."adm_api_token" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE
                 WHEN "t0"."token" IS NULL THEN 'to_activate'
                 WHEN "t0"."is_active" IS NOT TRUE THEN 'inactive'
                 WHEN "t0"."expires_ts" IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."expires_ts" < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP THEN 'expired'
                 ELSE 'active'
               END) AS "status" FROM "adm"."adm_api_token" AS "t0"
SELECT (COALESCE("t1"."__syscode","t1"."hierarchical_code")) AS "tag_code" FROM "adm"."adm_api_token_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "tag_description" FROM "adm"."adm_api_token_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT ("t0"."end_ts" IS NOT NULL) AS "completed" FROM "adm"."adm_backup" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t1"."firstname" IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t1"."firstname"||' '||"t1"."lastname"
                                            WHEN "t1"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t1"."lastname"
                                            ELSE "t1"."username" END
                                        ) AS "user_fullname" FROM "adm"."adm_connection" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."userid" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (string_agg((SELECT DISTINCT (COALESCE("s1_t1"."__syscode","s1_t1"."hierarchical_code")) AS "tag_code" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."tag_id" = "s1_t1"."id" WHERE "s1_t0"."group_code"="t0"."code"),',')) AS "group_tags" FROM "adm"."adm_group" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."url" AS "url" FROM "adm"."adm_group_helpdoc" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_helpdoc" AS "t1" ON "t0"."helpdoc_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_htag" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."id" = "s1_t1"."parent_id" WHERE "s1_t1"."parent_id"="t0"."id") AS "child_count" FROM "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN position('\:' in "t0"."filepath")>0 THEN '/'||"t0"."filepath"
             ELSE '/_vol/' || "t0"."filepath"
            END) AS "adapted_url" FROM "adm"."adm_htmltemplate_atc" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."label" AS "page_label" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_menu_page" AS "t1" ON "t0"."page_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."filepath" AS "page_filepath" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_menu_page" AS "t1" ON "t0"."page_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."tbl" AS "page_tbl" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_menu_page" AS "t1" ON "t0"."page_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."metadata" AS "page_metadata" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_menu_page" AS "t1" ON "t0"."page_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_menu" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."id" = "s1_t1"."parent_id" WHERE "s1_t1"."parent_id"="t0"."id") AS "child_count" FROM "adm"."adm_menu" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_notification" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."notification_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."confirmed" IS TRUE) AS "confirmed_count" FROM "adm"."adm_notification" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_notification" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."notification_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."confirmed" IS NOT TRUE) AS "pending_count" FROM "adm"."adm_notification" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT string_agg("s1_t0"."group_code",',') AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_group" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."user_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."group_code"!="t0"."group_code") AS "other_groups" FROM "adm"."adm_user" AS "t0"

SELECT (
                                            CASE WHEN "t0"."group_code" IS NOT NULL THEN "t0"."group_code" ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN "t0"."group_code" IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT string_agg("s1_t0"."group_code",',') AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_group" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."user_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."group_code"!="t0"."group_code") IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN (SELECT string_agg("s2_t0"."group_code",',') AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_group" AS "s2_t0" WHERE "s2_t0"."user_id"="t0"."id" AND "s2_t0"."group_code"!="t0"."group_code") IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT string_agg("s3_t0"."group_code",',') AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_group" AS "s3_t0" WHERE "s3_t0"."user_id"="t0"."id" AND "s3_t0"."group_code"!="t0"."group_code") ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN ("t0"."group_code" IS NOT NULL OR (SELECT string_agg("s4_t0"."group_code",',') AS "__value_0" FROM "adm"."adm_user_group" AS "s4_t0" WHERE "s4_t0"."user_id"="t0"."id" AND "s4_t0"."group_code"!="t0"."group_code") IS NOT NULL) AND (null) IS NOT NULL THEN ',' ELSE '' END ||
                                            CASE WHEN (null) IS NOT NULL THEN (null) ELSE '' END
                                        ) AS "all_groups" FROM "adm"."adm_user" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."firstname" IS NOT NULL AND "t0"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t0"."firstname"||' '||"t0"."lastname"
                                            WHEN "t0"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t0"."lastname"
                                            ELSE "t0"."username" END
                                        ) AS "fullname" FROM "adm"."adm_user" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."pkgid" IS NOT NULL THEN "t0"."pkgid"
                                               WHEN "t0"."tblid" IS NOT NULL THEN split_part("t0"."tblid",'.',1)
                                               ELSE NULL END) AS "calc_pkgid" FROM "adm"."adm_user_config" AS "t0"

SELECT (CAST(("t0"."tblid" IS NOT NULL) AS int)*8+
                                    CAST(("t0"."pkgid" IS NOT NULL) AS int)*2+
                                    CAST(("t0"."username" IS NOT NULL) AS int)*4+
                                    CAST(("t0"."user_group" IS NOT NULL) AS int)*1) AS "rank" FROM "adm"."adm_user_config" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."username" AS "user" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."user_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t1"."firstname" IS NOT NULL AND "t1"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t1"."firstname"||' '||"t1"."lastname"
                                            WHEN "t1"."lastname" IS NOT NULL THEN "t1"."lastname"
                                            ELSE "t1"."username" END
                                        ) AS "fullname" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."user_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."email" AS "email" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."user_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "tag_description" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."note" AS "tag_note" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."linked_table" AS "linked_table" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."require_2fa" AS "require_2fa" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (COALESCE("t1"."__syscode","t1"."hierarchical_code")) AS "tag_code" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_htag" AS "t1" ON "t0"."tag_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (COALESCE("t1"."username","t0"."group_code")) AS "user_or_group" FROM "adm"."adm_user_tag" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."user_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (%(f1_email)s ILIKE ANY(string_to_array("t0"."flags",','))) AS "is_mail" FROM "adm"."adm_userobject" AS "t0"
SELECT (%(f1_row)s ILIKE ANY(string_to_array("t0"."flags",','))) AS "is_row" FROM "adm"."adm_userobject" AS "t0"
SELECT (%(f1_print)s ILIKE ANY(string_to_array("t0"."flags",','))) AS "is_print" FROM "adm"."adm_userobject" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."start_date" + interval '6 days' ) AS "end_date" FROM "adm"."adm_week" AS "t0"
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") AS "n_invoices" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"
SELECT (SELECT SUM("s1_t0"."total") AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") AS "invoiced_total" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT "s1_t0"."id" AS "id" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id" ORDER BY "s1_t0"."date" DESC LIMIT 1) AS "last_invoice_id" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "__exists" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") AS "has_invoices" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") = 0 THEN 'Inactive' WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s2_t0" WHERE "s2_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") < 5 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Regular' END) AS "customer_rank" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."name" AS "state_name" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t1" ON "t0"."state" = "t1"."code"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "payment_description" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_payment_type" AS "t1" ON "t0"."payment_type_code" = "t1"."code"

SELECT "t2"."name" AS "region_name" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t1" ON "t0"."state" = "t1"."code" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_region" AS "t2" ON "t1"."region_code" = "t2"."code"
SELECT (LPAD(CAST("t0"."id" AS TEXT), 8, '0')) AS "account_code" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "__exists" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") AND (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s2_t0" WHERE "s2_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") >= 3) AS "is_active_valuable" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT (array_to_string(ARRAY((SELECT "s1_t0"."inv_number" AS "inv_number" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id" ORDER BY "s1_t0"."date" DESC LIMIT 5)), ', ')) AS "invoice_numbers" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT ((SELECT SUM("s1_t0"."total") AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s2_t0" WHERE "s2_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id"), 0)) AS "avg_invoice_value" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"

SELECT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "__exists" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."customer_id"="t0"."id") OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM invc.invc_invoice_note AS n INNER JOIN invc.invc_invoice AS i ON n.invoice_id = i.id WHERE i.customer_id = "t0"."id")) AS "has_activity" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."__is_draft" IS NOT TRUE) AS "is_confirmed" FROM "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t0"
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id") AS "row_count" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT "s1_t0"."product_id" AS "product_id" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id" ORDER BY "s1_t0"."_row_count" LIMIT 1) AS "first_product_id" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."account_name" AS "customer_name" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t1" ON "t0"."customer_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."state" AS "customer_state" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t1" ON "t0"."customer_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."total" > 1000 THEN 'High' WHEN "t0"."total" > 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END) AS "value_category" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

columns.message: invc.invoice.discount_tier_id: virtual navigation requires an additional compiler capability

columns.sql: SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG("s1_t0"."note_text", ' | ' ORDER BY "s1_t0"."priority") AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_note" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id") AS "all_notes" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT "s1_t0"."note_text" AS "note_text" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_note" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id" ORDER BY "s1_t0"."priority" LIMIT 1), 'No notes')) AS "priority_note" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."total" IS NULL THEN 'Draft'
                                              WHEN "t0"."total" = 0 THEN 'Empty'
                                              ELSE CASE WHEN "t0"."gross_total" > 5000 THEN 'Large'
                                                        WHEN "t0"."gross_total" > 1000 THEN 'Medium'
                                                        ELSE 'Small' END
                                         END) AS "invoice_status" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."total" > 1000 THEN %(f1_high_label)s
                                              WHEN "t0"."total" > 100 THEN %(f1_mid_label)s
                                              ELSE %(f1_low_label)s END) AS "status_label" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."inv_number" LIKE %(f1_pat_a)s THEN 'Series A'
                                              WHEN "t0"."inv_number" LIKE %(f1_pat_b)s THEN 'Series B'
                                              ELSE 'Other' END) AS "number_series" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."date" - MOD(CAST(EXTRACT(DOW FROM "t0"."date") AS integer) + 6, 7) * INTERVAL '1 day') AS "week_start" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s1_t0"."unit_price" IS NOT NULL) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id") AS "priced_rows_pct" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."total" > 1000 THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."unit_price" > 100) ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s2_t0" WHERE "s2_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id") END) AS "smart_row_count" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 AS "__exists" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id" AND "s1_t0"."unit_price" > 100) AS "has_expensive_rows" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT (COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."invoice_id"="t0"."id" GROUP BY "s1_t0"."product_id" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1), 0)) AS "duplicate_products" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."date" + INTERVAL '30 days') AS "due_date" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"
SELECT (CAST("t0"."__ins_ts" AS DATE) = "t0"."date") AS "created_same_day" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."date" >= %(env_workdate)s - INTERVAL '90 days') AS "is_recent" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t0"

SELECT "t2"."account_name" AS "customer_name" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t1" ON "t0"."invoice_id" = "t1"."id" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t2" ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."id"
SELECT "t1"."customer_id" AS "customer_id" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t1" ON "t0"."invoice_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "product_name" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT "t3"."name" AS "customer_state" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t1" ON "t0"."invoice_id" = "t1"."id" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t2" ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."id" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t3" ON "t2"."state" = "t3"."code"
SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."quantity" IN (1,2,3) THEN 'Small' WHEN "t0"."quantity" < 100 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Large' END) AS "size_category" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN "t1"."unit_price" > 500 THEN 'Premium' ELSE 'Standard' END) AS "product_note" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (COALESCE("t0"."unit_price", "t1"."unit_price")) AS "effective_price" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT ((("t0"."quantity" * "t0"."unit_price") > 1000) OR ("t0"."quantity" > 50 AND "t0"."unit_price" < 1)) AS "needs_review" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0"

SELECT (CASE WHEN (COALESCE("t0"."unit_price", "t1"."unit_price")) IS NULL THEN 'No price'
                                              WHEN (COALESCE("t0"."unit_price", "t1"."unit_price")) > "t1"."unit_price"
                                                   THEN 'Above list'
                                              WHEN (COALESCE("t0"."unit_price", "t1"."unit_price")) < "t1"."unit_price"
                                                   THEN 'Discounted'
                                              ELSE 'At list price' END) AS "pricing_analysis" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT "t4"."name" AS "customer_region" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t1" ON "t0"."invoice_id" = "t1"."id" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_customer" AS "t2" ON "t1"."customer_id" = "t2"."id" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t3" ON "t2"."state" = "t3"."code" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_region" AS "t4" ON "t3"."region_code" = "t4"."code"
SELECT (substr("t1"."code", 1, 3)) AS "product_code_prefix" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (ABS("t0"."unit_price" - "t1"."unit_price")) AS "abs_discount" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (LAG("t0"."quantity", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "t0"."invoice_id" ORDER BY "t0"."_row_count")) AS "prev_quantity" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0"
SELECT (CAST("t0"."unit_price" = "t1"."unit_price" AS boolean)) AS "matches_list_price" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT (array_length(ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT ir.product_id
                                                            FROM invc.invc_invoice_row AS ir
                                                            WHERE ir.invoice_id = "t0"."invoice_id"), 1)) AS "distinct_products_in_invoice" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0"

SELECT ("t1"."vat_type_code" IN (%(f1_exempt_codes_0)s, %(f1_exempt_codes_1)s)) AS "is_exempt_vat" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT "t1"."date" AS "invoice_date_static" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_invoice" AS "t1" ON "t0"."invoice_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (CAST("t0"."year" AS TEXT) || ': ' || CAST("t0"."unit_price" AS TEXT)) AS "price_label" FROM "invc"."invc_price_year" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "product_description" FROM "invc"."invc_price_year" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."id"

SELECT "t1"."unit_price" AS "price_year_price" FROM "invc"."invc_price_year_note" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_price_year" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."product_id" AND "t0"."year" = "t1"."year"

SELECT (CAST("t1"."year" AS TEXT) || ': ' || CAST("t1"."unit_price" AS TEXT)) AS "price_year_label" FROM "invc"."invc_price_year_note" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_price_year" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."product_id" AND "t0"."year" = "t1"."year"

SELECT "t2"."description" AS "product_description" FROM "invc"."invc_price_year_note" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_price_year" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_id" = "t1"."product_id" AND "t0"."year" = "t1"."year" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product" AS "t2" ON "t1"."product_id" = "t2"."id"
SELECT (SELECT SUM("s1_t0"."quantity") AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_invoice_row" AS "s1_t0" WHERE "s1_t0"."product_id"="t0"."id") AS "total_sold" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0"
SELECT (CASE WHEN "t0"."unit_price" > 500 THEN 'Premium' WHEN "t0"."unit_price" > 100 THEN 'Mid' ELSE 'Budget' END) AS "price_range" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0"
SELECT ("t0"."description" || ' (' || CAST("t0"."unit_price" AS TEXT) || ')') AS "price_label" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "product_type_name" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product_type" AS "t1" ON "t0"."product_type_id" = "t1"."id"
SELECT (substring("t0"."code" FROM 1 FOR 3)) AS "code_prefix_std" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0"
SELECT (CAST(CAST("t0"."unit_price" AS integer) AS text)) AS "price_as_int_text" FROM "invc"."invc_product" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_product_group" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product_group" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."id" = "s1_t1"."parent_id" WHERE "s1_t1"."parent_id"="t0"."id") AS "child_count" FROM "invc"."invc_product_group" AS "t0"

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "__value_0" FROM "invc"."invc_product_type" AS "s1_t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_product_type" AS "s1_t1" ON "s1_t0"."id" = "s1_t1"."parent_id" WHERE "s1_t1"."parent_id"="t0"."id") AS "child_count" FROM "invc"."invc_product_type" AS "t0"
SELECT "t1"."name" AS "state_name" FROM "invc"."invc_staff" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t1" ON "t0"."state" = "t1"."code"
SELECT "t1"."description" AS "role_description" FROM "invc"."invc_staff" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_staff_role" AS "t1" ON "t0"."role_code" = "t1"."code"

SELECT "t2"."name" AS "region_name" FROM "invc"."invc_staff" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_state" AS "t1" ON "t0"."state" = "t1"."code" LEFT JOIN "invc"."invc_region" AS "t2" ON "t1"."region_code" = "t2"."code"
SELECT "t1"."username" AS "username" FROM "invc"."invc_staff" AS "t0" LEFT JOIN "adm"."adm_user" AS "t1" ON "t0"."user_id" = "t1"."id"
